name.en: Good morning and see you tomorrow

description.pt: O pet dá bom dia no começo do dia e lembra de descansar no fim do expediente.
description.en: The pet says good morning at the start of the day and reminds you to rest at the end of the workday.
description.es: La mascota da los buenos días al empezar el día y recuerda descansar al final de la jornada.

pt: Bom dia! Bora fazer um dia bom?
Bom dia! Um café e a gente começa ☕
en: Good morning! Ready for a good day?
Good morning! A coffee and off we go ☕

say.pt: Fim do expediente! Hora de descansar um pouco.
say.en: End of the workday! Time to rest a little.
say.es: ¡Fin de la jornada! Hora de descansar un poco.
